content: Hi how can i assist you today
My smartwatch ECG trace draws letters I’m thinking of. I saw an M shape right as I thought ‘move’.
ECG lines fluctuate with motion, contact, and heart rhythm. The ‘M’ shape may reflect normal waveform peaks. Were you holding still with good contact?
I might have shifted my wrist.
Shifts can change the trace shape. A still reading followed by a deliberate small movement can show how the waveform shifts independent of thought content.
I’ll try both and compare the shapes.
Saving two screenshots labeled ‘still’ and ‘move’ should make the difference obvious.
